steps.title: Include the SDK
steps.summary: Build a Windows x64 UE4SS C++ mod with the versioned headers from the UNBSE include directory.

steps.title: Register the add-on
steps.summary: Locate UNBSE_QueryAddonHostV1, request ABI version 1, and register a namespaced descriptor with declared effects and required capabilities.

steps.title: Query services
steps.summary: Request only the messaging, script, runtime-information, or relocation interfaces the add-on uses.

steps.title: Retire cleanly
steps.summary: Stop work and retire the owner handle before the add-on unloads.

steps.title: Package and declare compatibility
steps.summary: Ship an enabled UE4SS mod and state the supported UNBSE and game versions.
